column1: # GENERATED CHILDREN AND close() (G8 phase 1). `close(pack(...))` seals
# the GENERATED SHAPE: the keys the data named are the allowed keys, and
# nothing else may be added — while the generated children themselves
# stay open to content, which is what makes an override compose.
# §10 — the language review's finding B acceptance suite). close()
# around a key()-bearing pack template used to resolve key() ONCE in
# the one shared inner map (the base func clone shares its args), so
# every generated child silently got the FIRST child's key; and a `_`
# hole inside a close()d pack template made the outer call report the
# template's hole as its own, so an ordinary overlay statement was
# absorbed INTO the hole instead of merging with the generated child.
